channel.title: Israel National News Flashes

item.title: Political drama: Erdan withdraws from race
item.description:
Gilad Erdan announced that the Unity Party he founded will not run in the upcoming elections.
According to Erdan, the party's current level of support does not make it highly likely to cross the electoral threshold, while efforts to join forces with additional parties have also failed to materialize.

item.title: Fear in Paris hotel: Elderly Israeli woman attacked in her sleep
item.description: An elderly Israeli woman was violently attacked, suffering multiple facial fractures, in her Paris hotel room in Paris. Her family heard her screams, overpowered the suspect, and alerted police.

item.title: PM praises soldiers for successful Samaria weapons raid
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu commented, "I commend our forces on a successful operation in Samaria in which they destroyed dozens of lathes for weapons manufacturing, seized dozens of weapons, and arrested individuals wanted for involvement in terrorism." "​Our activity to thwart terrorism continues with full force in Judea and Samaria, Gaza, Lebanon, and every place where our enemies attempt to threaten the State of Israel."

item.title: Amb. Huckabee: Violence against Palestinians causes damage to Israel
item.description: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee addressed Israeli violence against Palestinians in Judea and Samaria in an interview on Reshet Bet, saying that it reduced Israel's standing in the International community precisely when Israel is most in need of allies.

item.title: Standing firm, 25 years after September 11
item.description: Survival is not enough. There is also an obligation to preserve the truth about what happened.

item.title: Reserve general scraps plans for right-wing party
item.description: Lt. Col. (res.) Amir Aviv abandons plans to launch a new right-wing party, warning that too many competing lists could put the entire bloc’s path to victory at risk.

item.title: The Torah is a song - Are we listening?
item.description: Have we really been listening to the song? Have we allowed the Torah to speak to us again?

item.title: Foundation of repentance
item.description: It is supremely relevant that our national return to our homeland causes such paroxysms of fury among the nations of the world - and tragically among certain of our own people - who hate being confronted with the truth of the Torah’s decrees.

item.title: The immutable Esther Doctrine
item.description: Who could have imagined a politician cynically invoking the model of Esther to advocate for putting the Jewish people in danger in support of electing to power modern Haman-like enemies? Go out and vote to defeat those malign Jew-hating candidates. Opinion.

item.title: Iran has opened a new front - America’s Persian Gulf bases are now in the crosshairs
item.description: By targeting U.S. military positions across the Persian Gulf, Tehran is transforming a contained confrontation into a regional test of deterrence, escalation, and American resolve. Opinion.

item.title: Podcast: Better living conditions for Palestinians will not bring peace
item.description: A century of rejectionism shows economic improvements cannot substitute for accepting Israel’s existence, and warns of a growing anti-Israel trend in US politics.
